Related lists what an entity is tied to, grouped by how the edge reads from
it (depends on, used by, documented by, documents, tests, tested by,
changes with), each group by weight, with each neighbor's summary.

Usage:
  agent index related ID|PATH [flags]

Examples:
  agent index related alpha:src/lib.rs
  agent index related src/lib.rs --json

Flags:
      --budget int      Fit to this many tokens (0: no limit) (default 1500)
      --config string   The index configuration (TOML; default: AGENT_INDEX_CONFIG, else ~/.config/gomuxai/index.toml, else built-in defaults)
  -h, --help            help for related
      --json            Print the neighbors as JSON
      --store string    sqlite or pg (default: AGENT_INDEX_STORE, else [store].kind in the index configuration, else sqlite)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
